Please provide a precise location and evidence. A general statement such as "the proof is wrong" without an identifiable step or supporting evidence cannot be investigated.

## Exact location
Release/tag, document/section, artifact filename and SHA-256, and member path or line:

## Correction and supporting evidence
State the current wording, proposed correction and source/version/page that supports it. Distinguish released-witness identity and validity from pre-release generation ancestry.

## Effect on authority
Does this concern secondary documentation, an external premise, custody, licensing, or a validation claim? Explain whether the mathematical dependency chain is affected.
